environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy between NLB and application. Flask runs via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database contains production user records including salary data in the users table.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener (no HTTP inspection)
